teamsTruncated: This list shows the first 1,000 eligible teams. For a team outside the list, open its team page to propose a schedule.
title: Schedule proposals
intro: Propose dates for several teams at once. The teams are placed in dependency order, each with the teams placed before it as fixed dates, until the dates stop changing. Nothing changes until you accept.
teamsPlaceholder: Pick the teams to plan together
readOnly: A proposal is open, so the teams are locked — discard it first to pick other teams.
noTeamsHint: A team's manager or an administrator can run a proposal.
forbidden: Only a manager of every listed team or an administrator can propose or accept a schedule across teams
gone: A team of the proposal no longer exists — reload the page
invalid: The proposal could not be applied — propose again

facts.unsettled_one: Not settled after {{count}} pass: the teams depend on each other in a loop, so every pass moved something again. The dates shown are the last pass's — check the link warnings before you accept.
facts.unsettled_other: Not settled after {{count}} passes: the teams depend on each other in a loop, so every pass moved something again. The dates shown are the last pass's — check the link warnings before you accept.

section.loadIntro: The team's load per week after accepting the ticked moves. It only warns — nothing moves.
section.loadNone: Tick a move to see the load after accepting it.
section.notYours: Shown as it would be if this team's manager accepts these moves. You don't manage this team, so the ticks are not yours to set.
section.previewOnly: This is a preview. None of the moves shown is yours to accept — a team's manager or an administrator accepts that team's moves.

noCapacity: Nothing could be placed: the chosen teams have no capacity after {{date}} for the milestones to place — add a capacity period first.
rescoped: The plan of the chosen teams changed since the proposal: here is a fresh one. Your selection was kept for the milestones that still move.
stale: The plan changed in the meantime — nothing was saved. Propose again.
requesting: Asking for a proposal — the teams are locked until it arrives.
noTeamsAdmin: No team to propose for yet
noTeamsAdminHint: Create a team under Teams first.

saved.title: Saved proposals
saved.intro: The newest 20 saved runs, for another manager to open. Saving a 21st removes the oldest.
saved.loadFailed: Could not load the saved proposals
saved.emptyHint: Tick the moves of a proposal and save it for another manager to review.
saved.deleteBody: Delete the saved proposal “{{name}}”? The plan is not affected.
saved.deleteFailed: Could not delete the saved proposal
saved.deleteForbidden: Only an administrator or the manager of every team in it can delete a saved proposal
saved.deleteGone: This saved proposal is already gone — the list was reloaded
saved.saveIntro: Keeps this run with the moves you have ticked, for another manager to open. Nothing in the plan changes.
saved.nameLength: Enter a name of 1 to 100 characters
saved.nameInvalid: The name must not contain control characters
saved.saveForbidden: Only an administrator or the manager of every team in the run can save it
saved.saveInvalid: The proposal could not be saved as sent
saved.saveStale: The plan changed since this proposal was computed, so it was not saved. Propose again for the same teams — your ticks are kept.
saved.notFound: This saved proposal does not exist — it may have been deleted.
saved.facts: Saved by {{name}} on {{when}} · as of {{asOf}} · teams: {{teams}} · {{selected}} of {{total}} moves ticked · plan revision {{revision}}
saved.factsAnonymous: Saved on {{when}} · as of {{asOf}} · teams: {{teams}} · {{selected}} of {{total}} moves ticked · plan revision {{revision}}

stateNote.CURRENT: The plan still matches this proposal.
stateNote.CHANGED: The plan changed after it was saved, so it can no longer be accepted. Propose again to get a fresh one with the same ticks.
stateNote.UNREADABLE: It was saved by an older version of Astrolabe and cannot be shown. Propose again for the same teams to get a fresh one.

saved.outdated: Computed for {{date}}; propose again for today.
saved.readOnly: You can read it; only an administrator or the manager of every team in it can change the ticks and accept it.
saved.fresh: This is a fresh run for the same teams, not the saved proposal. Discard it to return to the saved one.
